styles.name: Black & Grey
styles.description: Shading built entirely from diluted black ink. Soft gradients, depth and contrast without colour.

styles.name: Realism
styles.description: Photographic detail rendered in skin. Portraits, animals and objects with lifelike light and texture.

styles.name: Fine Line
styles.description: Single-needle work. Thin, precise linework with delicate, restrained detail.

styles.name: Blackwork
styles.description: Bold solid black fields and heavy graphic shapes. High contrast, strong silhouettes.

styles.name: Minimal
styles.description: The least mark for the most meaning. Small, quiet, essential.

styles.name: Traditional
styles.description: American traditional. Bold outlines, limited palette, timeless iconography.

styles.name: Neo Traditional
styles.description: Traditional roots with richer colour, dimensional shading and decorative detail.

styles.name: Japanese
styles.description: Irezumi. Flowing compositions of dragons, koi, waves and blossoms built for the body.

styles.name: Ornamental
styles.description: Pattern as decoration. Mandalas, filigree and jewellery-like detail that follows the form.

styles.name: Geometric
styles.description: Precise shapes, symmetry and sacred geometry. Clean construction lines.

styles.name: Dotwork
styles.description: Tone and form rendered entirely in stippled dots. Patient, textural, meditative.

styles.name: Lettering
styles.description: Script, blackletter and custom type. Words carried with intent.

styles.name: Abstract
styles.description: Gesture, brushstroke and colour without a literal subject. Painterly and free.

styles.name: Trash Polka
styles.description: Realism collaged with brushstrokes, smears and type. Red and black, chaotic and deliberate.
